description: The historical 'stronger/specific in females' reading is not supported by the current canonical analysis.
evidence: Formal feature-by-sex interactions all q = 0.9; sex-stratified rho for mean movement is -0.41 (female, n=58) versus -0.42 (male, n=53) - near identical.
manuscript_impact: Any female-specific or female-stronger wording must be removed from the manuscript.
decision: Report as no detectable sex difference, with stratified estimates as descriptive only.
action: Encoded in behavior_sex_effect_contract.csv and claim F1-08.

description: Cage identity is not represented in the Stage 09 prediction design, so cage-level dependence is neither modelled nor assessable.
evidence: early_window_design_by_animal.csv carries AnimalNum, Group, Sex and window QC columns only; Analysis/09 sets cage_col <- NULL.
manuscript_impact: The out-of-sample estimate may be optimistic with respect to cage structure; must be stated as a limitation.
decision: Does not invalidate the prediction claim - it is a generalisation concern, not outcome leakage.
action: Stated in the Results and Methods drafts and in claim F1-10.

description: CombZ component z-scores are not reproducible in the repository under a single uniform rule.
evidence: The workbook encodes its reference population as hard-coded absolute row positions; recomputing block-aware still deviates by up to 2.0.
manuscript_impact: Methods must not claim CombZ is regenerated from raw data; downstream reproducibility (components -> CombZ -> labels) IS exact.
decision: Carry components verbatim; record external provenance.
action: Stated in outcome_score_contract.csv and the Methods draft.

description: Entropy_acf1 is not FDR-supported at the primary resolution and adds nothing beyond mean movement.
evidence: q = 0.067; bootstrap CI includes zero; partial r controlling movement = -0.057.
manuscript_impact: Must be reported as inconclusive, never as a positive third predictor.

description: The three-feature model does not improve on movement alone and no model-comparison test was performed.
manuscript_impact: Must not be described as an improvement or as significantly worse.

description: Behaviour-proteomics integration supports no main-text claim.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS section 10: no association reaches FDR < 0.05 and the script labels every one exploratory.
manuscript_impact: The proteomics manuscript's section 4 integration placeholder should not become a positive Results section.
decision: Keep out of the main text in both repositories.
